ch-strings-2.correct:
def count_vowels(text):
	return sum(ch.casefold() in "aeiou" for ch in text)

ch-loops-comprehensions-1.correct:
def sum_positive(numbers):
	return sum(n for n in numbers if n > 0)

ch-functions-3.correct:
def make_counter(start=0):
	current = start
	def counter():
		nonlocal current
		value = current
		current += 1
		return value
	return counter
